title: Chhota Bheem and the laddoos.
lines: In the kingdom of Dholakpur, in India, lives a boy called Bheem.
Everyone calls him Chhota Bheem.
Chhota means little.
But Bheem isn't little in strength!
He's the strongest boy in the whole land.
Bheem has a secret.
When he eats laddoos, he gets even stronger.
Laddoos are sweet, round balls.
His mummy makes the tastiest ones in the whole village.
Bheem has lots of friends.
Chutki is his best friend.
She makes the laddoos together with her mummy.
Raju is the smallest, and he's very brave.
Jaggu is a monkey who can talk and jumps from tree to tree.
And then there's Kalia and the twins Dholu and Bholu.
Kalia is big and a bit of a show-off.
He always wants to be better than Bheem.
One day there's a big party at the palace.
The king, Raja Indraverma, has a daughter.
Princess Indumati.
And it's her birthday.
Everyone from the village may come.
There are games, music and a big cake.
But during the party something terrible happens.
A big cloud of dust comes closer.
And out of the cloud come robbers on horses!
They are led by a man with a black moustache.
It's the wicked Kirmada.
He wants the kingdom for himself.
His robbers take the king's golden crown.
And they take Princess Indumati to their camp in the mountains.
Everyone is shocked.
The king cries.
Who can save my daughter?
he asks.
Bheem steps forward.
I'll go and get her, he says.
Kalia laughs.
You?
You're just a little boy!
But Bheem isn't afraid.
Chutki gives him a little bag of laddoos.
For when you need strength, she says.
Bheem, Raju and Jaggu set off.
Kalia comes too.
Because he doesn't want Bheem to be the only hero.
They walk through the forest.
They cross a river.
Jaggu jumps from tree to tree and looks down from above.
I can see the camp!
he shouts.
There, by the big rock!
In the camp the robbers are sitting around a fire.
The princess is in a wooden cage.
Kirmada laughs.
Nobody can stop me!
Bheem has a plan.
Jaggu, you make a noise on one side.
Raju, you creep up to the cage.
Kalia, you help Raju.
And I'll take care of the robbers.
Jaggu throws coconuts.
Bonk, bonk!
The robbers run towards him.
Raju and Kalia creep up to the cage.
Kalia is strong.
He pulls the door open.
Crack!
The princess is free.
But Kirmada sees it.
He comes charging with his robbers.
Bheem stands in the way.
He takes a laddoo out of his bag.
Chomp!
And he feels the strength in his arms.
He lifts a big tree trunk.
And he rolls it straight at the robbers.
The robbers fall over like skittles.
Kirmada falls in the mud.
He's so dirty that he runs away.
And the robbers run after him.
Bheem takes the golden crown.
Together they bring Princess Indumati back to the palace.
Everyone cheers.
The king is so happy.
Bheem, you're a real hero!
Bheem shakes his head.
It wasn't just me, he says.
Jaggu, Raju and Kalia helped too.
Kalia goes all red.
He shakes Bheem's hand.
You're a good friend, Bheem.
That evening the party goes on.
And the king has the biggest plate of laddoos in the whole land brought out.
For all the children of Dholakpur.
The end.
